scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite integration project extended from 3 months to 9+ months with no resolution (intensity 9/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → Integration Development) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations complex and unstable (intensity 8/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → Customization Management) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales team loses 3 days per week to admin and meetings instead of selling (intensity 8/10, stage: Sales Territory Optimization → Sales Execution)
4. [DataSignalFriction] Lack of customer intelligence in route planning requires manual information gathering (intensity 7/10, stage: Sales Territory Optimization → Customer Intelligence Preparation)
5. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Staff forced to use multiple disparate systems due to integration failures (intensity 7/10, stage: Technology Integration Foundation → Operational Stability)
6. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order-takers rather than proactive sellers due to lack of tools (intensity 6/10, stage: Partner Distribution Management → Sales Support Provision)
7. [GovernanceRiskFriction] Cannot enforce CRM activity metrics due to system reliability concerns (intensity 6/10, stage: Sales Territory Optimization → Activity Tracking)
